rationale: test/harness/rt_allocation_probe.{hpp,cpp} (matched by the test/harness/** selector) gains RtAllocationProbe::self_check(), a positive control for the RT allocation probe, with its own Catch2 suite and a docs paragraph. The probe counts heap allocations in DSP tests; it is not part of any visual-proof, screenshot, golden, capture or render surface. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
